charge_description: having in his possession one fifty-six pound weight which was short by one ounce and 14 drams, another fifty-six pound weight which was short by one ounce and 12 drams, one twenty-eight pound weight which was short by two ounces and four drams, and one seven-pound weight which was short by one ounce and eight drams
